result.summary: The page is largely coherent and functional. Only minor cosmetic issues were found: a delivery badge that sits awkwardly against the rounded image corner on the popular-item card, and slightly awkward separator punctuation in the promotional banner. No broken functionality, missing critical elements, or accessibility blockers are apparent.

issues.description: The "€0 delivery" badge on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card overlaps the top-left corner of the food image, partially covering the dark background and appearing visually cramped against the rounded card corner.
issues.suggestion: Reposition the badge slightly inward or add more padding so it sits cleanly within the image area without crowding the card's corner.

issues.description: The promo banner text "Use code TALLINN3 at checkout • min. order €10" appears to have a stray bullet or misaligned separator dot between the code and the minimum order text.
issues.suggestion: Verify the banner string and use a consistent separator with proper spacing, or split the text into separate styled elements.
